negative_results.proposition: The three remaining ambiguous G9 legacy rules cannot be safely auto-normalized from source syntax alone.
negative_results.evidence: Each legacy line admits at least two materially distinct plausible ASTs with distinct semantic hashes; selecting one would add semantics not established by the text.

negative_results.proposition: A fail-open relation surface accepting arbitrary unregistered relation identifiers is not justified for BASE.
negative_results.evidence: The registry-gated probe rejected 10000/10000 unknown relation mutations and 10000/10000 wrong-arity mutations; earlier permissive rule-surface work accepted generated nonsense relations 5000/5000.
